after.title: Oat flapjacks - Kitchen notebook
blocks: - a handful of dried apricots, chopped
Mash the bananas with a fork until smooth, then fold in the oats, apricots and cinnamon. Leave the mixture to stand for ten minutes so the oats soften.
Spread into a lined tin, bake until golden at the edges and cut into squares once cool.
